description: This file defines the class 'nusoap_client', a high-level PHP class for simplifying SOAP client interactions, along with related classes and methods for handling SOAP requests, responses, WSDL parsing, and HTTP transport. It also provides backwards compatibility classes and handles various SOAP communication details.

classes.name: nusoap_client
classes.description: Main class providing high-level SOAP client functionality, including method calls, WSDL handling, HTTP transport, and response parsing.

classes.name: soapclient
classes.description: Backward compatibility class alias for nusoap_client if PHP soap extension is not loaded.

classes.name: nusoapclient
classes.description: Alias for nusoap_client for backward compatibility, created when PHP soap extension is not present.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the SOAP client with endpoint URL, WSDL flag, proxy, timeout, and port name.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Performs a SOAP method call with parameters, headers, and options, returning the deserialized response or false on error.

methods.name: checkWSDL
methods.description: Verifies and loads WSDL operations and binding types.

methods.name: loadWSDL
methods.description: Instantiates and fetches the WSDL file for parsing.

methods.name: getOperationData
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific operation from the WSDL.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Handles the HTTP transport to send SOAP envelope and receive the response.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses the SOAP response, extracting headers, body, and encoding.

methods.name: setCurlOption
methods.description: Sets custom cURL options for HTTP transport.

methods.name: setEndpoint
methods.description: Overrides the endpoint URL for the SOAP service.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Sets SOAP headers for the request.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves received SOAP response headers.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the parsed SOAP response header.

methods.name: setHTTPProxy
methods.description: Sets proxy server details for HTTP connection.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Sets HTTP authentication credentials.

methods.name: setHTTPEncoding
methods.description: Configures HTTP encoding (like gzip).

methods.name: setUseCURL
methods.description: Specifies whether to prefer cURL for HTTP transfer.

methods.name: useHTTPPersistentConnection
methods.description: Enables persistent HTTP connections.

methods.name: getDefaultRpcParams
methods.description: Gets default setting for RPC parameters (deprecated).

methods.name: setDefaultRpcParams
methods.description: Sets default for RPC parameters (deprecated).

methods.name: getProxy
methods.description: Creates a dynamic proxy class for WSDL operations.

methods.name: _getProxyClassCode
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the dynamic proxy class.

methods.name: getProxyClassCode
methods.description: Returns the generated proxy class code.

methods.name: getHTTPBody
methods.description: Constructs the HTTP payload for the SOAP message.

methods.name: getHTTPContentType
methods.description: Returns the HTTP Content-Type header value.

methods.name: getHTTPContentTypeCharset
methods.description: Returns charset for Content-Type based on encoding.

methods.name: decodeUTF8
methods.description: Enables or disables UTF-8 decoding in parsing.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the internal cookie jar.

methods.name: getCookies
methods.description: Returns all cookies stored.

methods.name: checkCookies
methods.description: Removes expired cookies from the jar.

methods.name: UpdateCookies
methods.description: Merges new cookies into existing cookie jar.
